blocks.text: COTABATO CITY — Authorities in Tawi-Tawi arrested five suspected smugglers and seized over P7.9 million worth of smuggled cigarettes during a joint law enforcement seaborne patrol in the coastal waters of Tahaw, Languyan, Tawi-Tawi on Thursday, Nov. 19. Brig. Gen. Christopher Abecia, regional director of Police Regional Office-Bangsamoro Autonomous Region (PRPO-BAR), said the operation was led by the 1st Special Operations Unit of the Maritime Group (1st SOU-MG), backed by other police units stationed in Tawi-Tawi. During the patrol operation, the joint teams intercepted a motorized banca identified as FB “Princess Rai,” with five individuals on board. Abecia said the operation […]...
